failure: page.waitForFunction Orbit.route.key timeout 30000ms before performance selector threshold
rootCause: The shared route helper waited up to 30 seconds for Orbit.route.key before the dedicated 6-second Cliente360/Cobros usable-surface assertion could run, so a helper timeout masked the actual product-performance measurement.
fix: Route helper now confirms only hash navigation with a 2-second bound; the module-specific ready selector remains the authoritative <=6-second performance gate.
